title: Robust Covariance Estimation for Entry-wise Contaminated and Partially Observed Data via Expectation Maximization Algorithm
abstract: arXiv:2610.21709v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robust covariance estimation under entry-wise contamination and missing data is challenging in various signal processing applications. Under the Student-$t$ model, observation-level reweighting induces a uniform attenuation across samples, which can lead to cumulative information loss even when most coordinates remain informative. The alternative Student-$t^*$ model enables coordinate-wise robustness, but its E-step is not available in closed form. We extend inference for the Student-$t^*$ model to incomplete observations through a stochastic approximation EM (SAEM) algorithm operating on a reduced latent space: stochastic updates of the coordinate-wise scales are combined with Rao-Blackwellized Gaussian conditional moments, which avoids explicit sampling of latent Gaussian variables while preserving a likelihood-based framework. translated_title: 基于期望最大化算法的逐元素污染与部分观测数据的鲁棒协方差估计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.21709v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：在各种信号处理应用中，逐元素污染和缺失数据下的鲁棒协方差估计是一个具有挑战性的问题。在Student-$t$模型下，观测级重加权会在样本间产生一致的衰减，即使大多数坐标仍包含有用信息，也可能导致累积的信息损失。另一种Student-$t^*$模型可以实现坐标级的鲁棒性，但其E步不存在闭式解。我们通过一个在缩减潜空间上运行的随机近似EM（SAEM）算法，将Student-$t^*$模型的推断扩展到不完整观测情形：将坐标级尺度的随机更新与Rao-Blackwell化的高斯条件矩相结合，在避免对潜在高斯变量进行显式采样的同时，保持了基于似然的框架。在合成数据和真实传感器数据上的实验表明，相比高斯、Student-$t$、插补方法，该方法具有更低的Fisher-Rao误差（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种在缩减潜空间上运行的随机近似EM（SAEM）算法，通过将坐标级尺度的随机更新与Rao-Blackwell化的高斯条件矩相结合，实现了逐元素污染与缺失数据下Student-$t^*$模型的鲁棒协方差估计，无需对潜在高斯变量显式采样。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a stochastic approximation EM (SAEM) algorithm on a reduced latent space, combining stochastic coordinate-wise scale updates with Rao-Blackwellized Gaussian conditional moments to enable robust covariance estimation under the Student-t* model for entry-wise contaminated and partially observed data, without explicit sampling of latent Gaussian variables.
